records.prompt: Edit this existing vintage British-bureaucratic mechanical bidding console illustration. Preserve the entire apparatus, composition, colours, lighting, texture, controls, apertures, gauges and background exactly. Change only the small heraldic crest centred near the top of the left teal arch: completely remove the crown, lion, unicorn, shield and all royal/heraldic imagery. Replace them with a clearly fictional, neutral brass archival filing emblem made from three simple stacked index-card drawers inside a circular cog-like medallion. It must not resemble a coat of arms, crown, government seal, police badge, military insignia or any real institution. No words, letters, numbers, flags, buttons, watermarks or new gameplay information. Keep the new emblem small and decorative in the same location.

records.prompt: Precise object edit of this existing British mid-century bureaucratic cartography apparatus artwork. Preserve the exact 3:2 composition, camera, palette, lighting, timber and brass machinery, and every large blank functional aperture and panel. Remove every crown, crowned crest, heraldic lion, coat of arms, royal monogram, shield, national emblem, and governmental insignia. Replace those symbols only with small, clearly fictional non-heraldic geometric motifs based on an abstract compass rose combined with stacked filing tabs; no crown, no shield, no animals, no letters. Keep all blank apertures empty and uncluttered so accessible HTML map and controls can be placed precisely over them. No words, no labels, no numbers, no buttons, no UI text. Production game background, photoreal painted machinery, clean edges.
